name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: Forsaken forces strike Hillsbrad town, aiming to break its human rule. High Executor Darthalia directs the assault from Tarren Mill.

sections.title: Decapitating the Town Council
sections.body: Hillsbrad's human defenders cling to their remaining authority despite heavy losses in the fields and patrols. High Executor Darthalia knows that peasants and militia rally behind the town's leaders. She sends Forsaken operatives into the Town Hall to kill Magistrate Burnside and five councilmen, cutting off the town's command.

sections.title: Erasing the Civic Record
sections.body: Darthalia aims to break Hillsbrad's civic life as well as its leadership. She orders operatives to burn the Hillsbrad Proclamation, a political document tied to the settlement's charter and pride. They also seize the town registry, taking official records and citizen rolls from surviving Alliance loyalists. The registry gives Undercity's intelligence a detailed view of the local people.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia, the Forsaken commander at Tarren Mill, directs the assault as part of her campaign against Alliance settlements in the foothills.
Magistrate Burnside leads Hillsbrad's human government. He is in the Town Hall with his councilors and uses arcane magic to defend the town's remaining authority.
The Hillsbrad Proclamation is a political charter kept in the Town Hall. It embodies the town's law and civic pride, so its destruction strikes at local morale.

faq.q: Why does Darthalia want the town registry?
faq.answer: The town registry holds a census and civic records for Hillsbrad's people. Taking it deprives surviving humans of their records and gives the Forsaken information about who remains nearby.

faq.q: Where does this fight take place?
faq.answer: The targets are in and around Hillsbrad's large Town Hall, in the human settlement in the southern foothills between Tarren Mill and Southshore.

faq.q: What role do the councilmen play?
faq.answer: The Hillsbrad Councilmen help Magistrate Burnside govern the town. They are spellcasters who defend the Town Hall and its surrounding grounds.

angles.text: For the Horde, striking the Town Hall weakens the Alliance's ability to coordinate local militia and helps secure Tarren Mill's southern frontier from human counterattacks.
As an Undead, you see the Forsaken's campaign against Hillsbrad's human rule as both expansion and retribution against the living who dispute Lordaeron's borders.
For the Alliance, Magistrate Burnside's death and the burning of the town charter mark the fall of Hillsbrad's last legitimate local government.
